query: How does ARIA risk under anti-amyloid monoclonal antibodies differ for ApoE ε4/ε4 homozygotes versus heterozygotes or non-carriers?

correct_answer: Highest ARIA in ε4/ε4, intermediate heterozygotes, lowest non-carriers.
Gradient consistent across pivotal trials; absolute rates differ by drug.

pubmed.title: ARIA risk by ApoE genotype with lecanemab
pubmed.summary: ARIA-E incidence was highest in ApoE ε4/ε4 homozygotes, intermediate in ε4 heterozygotes, and lowest in non-carriers receiving lecanemab. Symptomatic ARIA concentrated in homozygotes.

openalex.title: Donanemab ARIA stratified by ApoE
openalex.summary: Donanemab trials show the same genotype gradient for ARIA-H and ARIA-E though absolute rates differ from lecanemab. This is a scope difference between drugs, not a contradiction of the gradient.
